objective: Two separate supervised models: find hindsight-good entries for all recorded native tokens showing >=10% rolling24h gains, with as-of news; learn exits for those same teacher entries with no news.
target_definition: Scan every native token every5m. A rally is a >=10% rolling24h close-to-close gain, with at most one anchor per token per24h. For each anchor search executable entries in the previous24h through the anchor; for each entry search exits5m to24h after its actual fill. Pick the maximum gross-return pair. Positive entry labels are within one5m bar of that optimum and retain >=95% of its gain. Keep only profitable teachers; retain eligible non-rally/non-target observations as negatives. Future prices and future rally membership are labels only.
candidate_rules: Continuous five-minute decisions across all recorded native symbols, with one position per symbol. The >=10% rule identifies historical supervised targets and is not a live-entry gate. SMA indicators remain input features; no SMA pair is selected as a prerequisite. The hard24h position limit starts at actual entry.
entry_inputs: Past market, spot, BTC/ETH, derivatives, available quotes, SMA/crossover state and as-of news document/topic/signal features. News availability uses max(publication, collection, availableAt); historical signal revisions and evidence must precede the decision.
exit_inputs: Separate preprocessing and network. Past market/spot/derivatives/SMA/crossover state plus actual entry price-relative return, elapsed holding time, running gain/drawdown since entry and remaining time. No news columns, entry-model score, or news-trained latent representation.
training: Class-balanced supervised binary cross-entropy for each separate network. Entry targets are hindsight-good points. Exit training uses exactly the same optimal teacher entries; target SELL at the optimal exit, HOLD before it, with post-target states labeled SELL for recovery. No model-generated or test entries are inserted into exit training.
selection: Entry checkpoint chosen by validation average precision on eligible decision states; exit checkpoint and threshold chosen by returns at the fixed teacher validation entries. With these models fixed, choose entry threshold on chronological validation end-to-end gross profit with cash allowed. Exit thresholds [.25,.5,.75]; entry thresholds [.5,.75,.9]. Compare same learned entries with fixed24h exits, teacher entries with learned exits (diagnostic), and cash.
splitting: Global chronological cuts. State labels mature48h32m after their decision, covering the full potential rally-anchor and exit search. Training label completion must precede test start minus24h. Inner validation starts with the latest two distinct mature training dates, expanding backward by whole dates only until at least five positive entry targets are available; use the same24h label purge. This coverage-based rule uses earlier labels, never test outcomes. Live test entries stop24h32m before fold end; remaining positions close before models change. Teacher tests require both entry and full label search inside the test fold. Earlier dates were researched previously; not pristine holdouts.
archive_boundary_policy: No replay entry starts in the final24h32m of its own source archive, even when the validation calendar includes a gap between archives. A position may never cross an archive or symbol boundary.
deployment: Research artifacts only; no trading activation or orders. Preserve previous experiments. Raw data and Python environment in persistent external Windows storage.
